html:
Question 1
?

For which of the following vector fields is f(x,y,z)=e2x−y−z a potential function?

a
2i−j−k
b
2e2x−y−zi−e2x−y−zj−e2x−y−zk
c
i+j+k
d
2e2x−y−zi+e2x−y−zj+e2x−y−zk
e
e2x−y−zi−e2x−y−zj−e2x−y−zk
Submit
